description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
 
 
 
 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Software Development Engineer In Test, to apply advanced software engineering skills to improve quality across the development lifecycle through scalable test frameworks, developer tooling, and reusable automation solutions. This is a senior individual contributor role for a developer who specializes in testing, testability, and quality engineering.

 This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership across teams. The individual will influence architecture, strengthen automation strategy, improve developer feedback loops, and help establish consistent quality engineering practices that scale across products and platforms. The role carries strong Software Development Engineer in Test expectations, with an emphasis on building engineering solutions that improve product quality, platform reliability, and development velocity.

 Primary Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and evolve scalable test frameworks, automation libraries, and developer-facing quality tools
 Understand how the broader software ecosystem works together and define quality engineering approaches that align to platform strategy
 Partner with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to define test strategy, coverage goals, and acceptance criteria
 Build reusable utilities, harnesses, mocks, stubs, and data solutions that improve system testability and validation efficiency
 Develop specialized test strategies and harnesses for conversational AI systems across Voice and Chat channels
 Support quality across APIs, backend services, and full-stack workflows, including distributed and multi-service environments
 Validate complex multi-turn conversations, intent recognition, orchestration logic, and agent interactions
 Integrate automated quality checks into CI/CD pipelines to support fast, reliable feedback loops across teams
 Establish and promote best practices for framework selection, test data strategy, automation design, and engineering-led quality
 Create clear patterns, examples, and documentation that make testing more accessible and reduce friction for engineers
 Identify quality gaps, recommend scalable solutions, and drive improvements that strengthen release confidence and customer experience
 Influence architecture and engineering design decisions with a focus on quality risks, test strategy, and long-term maintainability
 Investigate complex defects, analyze failure trends, and support root-cause resolution across development and test environments
 Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers to strengthen developer-led testing practices and overall quality engineering maturity
 Pair with developers on complex quality and testability challenges and contribute directly to implementation when needed
 
 Required Qualifications 
 7+ years of experience in software development, test engineering, or quality engineering roles, including significant experience in SDET or developer-led test infrastructure work
 Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as TypeScript or Java.
 Deep experience building test frameworks, automation infrastructure, harnesses, or developer tooling in modern engineering environments
 Strong understanding of software design, object-oriented design, distributed systems, debugging, APIs, and maintainable code practices
 Experience supporting quality across backend services, APIs, and full-stack systems
 Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD workflows and improving engineering feedback loops
 Experience designing and maintaining test data strategies and reusable testing patterns
 Experience defining technical standards or reusable solutions that support multiple teams
 Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction as a senior individual contributor
 Strong communication skills, including the ability to document patterns, mentor engineers, and articulate quality strategy clearly
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with conversational AI platforms, AI agents, or multi-turn workflow validation
 Experience testing Voice and Chat experiences with channel-specific test methodologies
 Experience with API testing, mocking, and contract testing
 Experience with developer tooling, service virtualization, or environment-aware testing approaches
 Experience improving automation maturity or quality engineering standards across an organization
 Experience with performance, resiliency, or reliability testing
 Experience evaluating AI or LLM-based responses using emerging validation approaches
 Experience working in highly regulated or large-scale enterprise environments
 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (Highschool diploma plus 4 years relevant work experience)

 
 
 Pay Range 
 The typical pay range for this role is:
 
$130,295.00 - $284,280.00 
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls.  The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.  This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.  This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. 
 
 Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.
 
 Great benefits for great people 
 
 We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.


This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. 
Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments .

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/30/2026 
 
 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.
